{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)

# Identify converted-but-refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
converted_and_refunded = (df['converted'] == 1) & refunded_mask

# Define the valid population: converted AND age not -1 AND not QA AND not refunded
valid_converted = (df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1) & (~qa_mask) & (~refunded_mask)

# Compute the number of valid converted customers
num_valid_converted = valid_converted.sum()
print(f'Number of valid converted customers (excluding QA and refunded): {num_valid_converted}')

# Compute mean age for valid converted customers
mean_age = df.loc[valid_converted, 'customer_age'].mean()
print(f'Mean age of valid converted customers: {mean_age}')

# Round to two decimal places for reporting
mean_age_rounded = round(mean_age, 2)
print(f'Rounded mean age: {mean_age_rounded}')"}
